name: queryGetCellByIndex
description: return the value of a specific query cell
syntax: queryGetCellByIndex( query query, string column_name, string index, [any defaultValue] )

params.name: query
params.description: query to get cell value from

params.name: defaultValue
params.description: In case no matching index was found, this value is returned by the function, in case it is not set, the function will throw an exception.
